verdict.rationale: cubic offers several programmatic surfaces beyond its UI. Its official MCP server lets agents read findings and codebase context, request PR reviews, triage PR and scan issues, and manage subscriptions and seats. It also has a read-only Analytics API, a CLI for local review, and config-as-code via cubic.yaml. There is no evidence of a general-purpose public API with UI parity, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404; missing for 10: a documented general REST API or OpenAPI spec, programmatic control of settings, integrations, wiki, custom-agent library adoption and codebase-scan launching, and any explicit API/UI parity statement or independent corroboration.
